_comment: Procedure slides and voiceovers pulled from the MS/HS session shell and the K-6 resource page. A segment of type "procedure" points at one of these with "ref". Audio files were already real mp3s beside the old shell; they are copied under media/audio so the TV does not depend on the archived pages.

entry.title: How class starts
lines: Come in. Go to your seat.
Look at the screen.
Read the Launch Activity
It's already there. Nobody has to tell you.
Start it
You are not waiting on me. I'll be taking attendance.
Finish it
Before the screen moves on.

attention.title: The attention signal
lines: An adult puts a hand up
Any adult. Any day.
You stop talking
That's the whole signal.
You do not put your hand up back
You don't have to do anything. You just stop.
About three seconds
Not thirty.

cleanup.title: Cleanup
lines: The screen turns red
Not when you feel like it. Not when someone tells you.
Three tones, going down
Listen for it. You don't have to be watching.
Same thing every day
Every class in this room.

help.title: When you have a question
lines: Look at your table first
Is anyone already finished?
Ask them
Someone finished can help you.
Nobody finished? Hand up.
Keep working on something else while you wait.
Don't call across the room
And don't get up to go find an adult.

early.title: When you finish early
lines: You become the person your table can ask
Help them — don't do it for them
Take it out of their hands and you finished their work.
A table is done when the table is done
Not when you personally are done.
Whole table finished? Then it's your time.

seats.title: Your seat
lines: The seat you're in today is your assigned seat
Until further notice.
Same seat, every day
Without being asked.
It changes only if I move you

shutdown.title: Shutting down
lines: Save. Log out. Close the lid.
Two hands, carried closed
Your numbered slot — not an open one.
Charger in. Check the light.
No light? Say so before you walk away.
Back to your seat
The bell releases you, not the cart.

report.title: When something's wrong with it
lines: Say so right away
Not at the end of class. Not tomorrow.
Don't trade. Don't take another one.
A quiet swap moves the problem onto someone else's name.
Accidents happen. Equipment breaks.
That's normal. Nobody's in trouble for it.
All I need is to know
A machine nobody tells me about doesn't get fixed.

reset.title: The end of class
lines: Elementary is in here in five minutes
They shouldn't be able to tell we were here.
Every table has a reset job
Yours changes every week. You'll know it before you stand up.
Tables clear. Chairs in. Boxes on the shelf.
Nobody touches the animals

k6-entry.title: How class starts
lines: Come in with your teacher
Walking. Quiet voices.
Go to your seat
The screen will already be on. Look at it.
Sit quietly until you get instructions
Nothing to touch yet. Just wait.

k6-attention.title: The attention signal
lines: An adult puts a hand up
Any adult. Any day.
You stop talking
That is the whole signal. You don't raise yours back.
About three seconds
Not thirty.

k6-colors.title: The colors around the screen
lines: RED border: you are in your seat
No exceptions, no asking.
AMBER border: up, but stay at your table
Your own table's area only.
GREEN border: you may be up
Still walking. Always walking.

k6-help.title: When you have a question
lines: Raise your hand and wait
An adult will come to you.
Don't call out
And don't get up to find someone.

k6-early.title: When you finish early
lines: Help someone at your table
Help them — don't do it for them.
Don't take it out of their hands
That isn't helping. That's finishing their work.
When your whole table is done, that time is yours

k6-cleanup.title: Cleanup
lines: The screen turns red
And makes three tones, going down. Listen for it.
Stop building. Start cleaning.
Not when you feel like it — when it turns red.
Same thing every day

k6-reset.title: Reset your station
lines: Table cleared
Nothing left on it.
Chair pushed in
All the way.
Floor checked
If it is under your table, it is yours.

k6-seats.title: Where you sit
lines: Your teacher tells you where to sit
Listen for it, then go straight there.
It might not be last week's seat
That is normal.
Sit where you are put
No swapping, no asking to move.

k6-breaks.title: If something breaks, tell an adult
lines: Say so right away
Not at the end. Not tomorrow.
Things break. That is normal.
Nobody is in trouble for an accident.
We can't fix what we don't know about
